title: Zophar Speaks: The Triumph of the Wicked Is Short

questions.question: Who answers Job in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Job 20:1 (ESV): "Then Zophar the Naamathite answered and said:"

questions.question: The exulting of the wicked is what?
questions.explanation: Job 20:5 (ESV): "that the exulting of the wicked is short, and the joy of the godless but for a moment?"

questions.question: Though his height mount up to the heavens, he will perish forever like his own what?
questions.explanation: Job 20:6–7 (ESV): "Though his height mount up to the heavens... he will perish forever like his own dung..."

questions.question: He will fly away like a what?
questions.explanation: Job 20:8 (ESV): "He will fly away like a dream and not be found; he will be chased away like a vision of the night."

questions.question: He returns what he has labored for and does not what?
questions.explanation: Job 20:18 (ESV): "He returns what he has labored for and does not swallow it down..."

questions.question: Because he has crushed and abandoned whom?
questions.explanation: Job 20:19 (ESV): "For he has crushed and abandoned the poor; he has seized a house that he did not build."

questions.question: His children will seek the favor of whom?
questions.explanation: Job 20:10 (ESV): "His children will seek the favor of the poor, and his hands will give back his wealth."

questions.question: Though poison is sweet in his mouth, it turns to what in his stomach?
questions.explanation: Job 20:12, 14 (ESV): "Though evil is sweet in his mouth... yet his food is turned in his stomach; it is the venom of cobras within him."

questions.question: God casts the fruit of his belly out of his what?
questions.explanation: Job 20:15 (ESV): "He swallows down riches and vomits them up again; God casts them out of his belly."

questions.question: The eye that saw him will see him no more, nor will his what any more behold him?
questions.explanation: Job 20:9 (ESV): "The eye that saw him will see him no more, nor will his place any more behold him."

questions.question: The heavens will reveal his iniquity, and the earth will rise up against whom?
questions.explanation: Job 20:27 (ESV): "The heavens will reveal his iniquity, and the earth will rise up against him."

questions.question: Utter darkness is laid up for his what?
questions.explanation: Job 20:26 (ESV): "Utter darkness is laid up for his treasures; a fire not fanned will devour him..."

questions.question: Every man's hand that is in misery shall come upon whom?
questions.explanation: Job 20:22 (ESV): "In the fullness of his sufficiency he will be in distress; the hand of everyone in misery will come against him."

questions.question: To fill his belly to the full, God will send his fierce anger into him, and rain it upon him as his what?
questions.explanation: Job 20:23 (ESV): "To fill his belly to the full, God will send his fierce anger into him, and rain it upon him as his food."

questions.question: He will flee from an iron weapon; a bronze arrow will strike him where?
questions.explanation: Job 20:24 (ESV): "He will flee from an iron weapon; a bronze arrow will strike him through."

key_verse_text: The exulting of the wicked is short, and the joy of the godless but for a moment.
